analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI is trading sideways in neutral territory, and MACD histogram improvement is marginal. While the 5-day return was +1.06%, resistance is confirmed near the 20-day moving average ($1,891.09). The weekly ADX at 25.7 indicates an existing trend, but the daily directionality is absent. At 11.2% from the 52-week low, downside risk is limited, yet upside reversal signals are also weak.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($1,891.06) vs SMA5 ($1,899.97) / SMA20 ($1,891.09) / SMA50 ($1,808.43) — Near SMA20, above SMA50, indicating a neutral short-term trend.
· Below SMA100 ($1,893.73) and SMA200 ($2,039.36) — Suggests a weak medium to long-term trend.
· 52-week Position (11.2%) — Current price is 28.5% above the 52-week low and 61.8% below the 52-week high.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (55.0→52.5) — Continues in neutral territory, showing weakening momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-5.6959→-4.8543) — Improving, maintaining a bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Midline $1,891.09) — Trading around the midline with a narrowing band width of 5.64%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($1,821.49) — Based on Pivot S1 ($1,816.21) and the 20-day low.
· Swing Resistance ($1,944.16) — Approaching the upper Bollinger Band ($1,944.41) and Pivot R1 ($1,971.19).
· 5-day/20-day Price Range Pattern — Sideways consolidation, with no clear Higher Low or Lower High formation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.21x) — Normal level of confidence for recent price action.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase) — Lack of directional momentum, maintaining a wait-and-see approach pending a breakout above support ($1,821.49) or resistance ($1,944.16).
